confidence_notes: Food and draft beer use Japan-wide price references with a modest Hakone visitor-market uplift; local hostel ranges are broad. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated relative to beer. Hotel anchors are holistic estimates, and Hakone’s ryokan-heavy lodging mix adds uncertainty.
comparable_city_reasoning: Used Japan-wide food and drink prices as a baseline, adjusted for Hakone's tourism market, with Hakone-specific hostel ranges. No close comparable city used.
